notes.title: New Event "New Saga in Alchemy World ～Part 2～" Starts!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/b79b375a2b3bdafd321f08c0f403386ed0d5455d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Following the divine message, the explorers set out to fight the threat from another world.
Thanks to their efforts defeating the black Yoromis, the otherworldly influence on this world began to fade.
It seemed only a matter of time before Kyle and Sildonia could safely return home.
However, a new divine message arrives: a fresh crisis has emerged, and the effects of the other world have begun to grow once again...

What is this new threat?
Will Kyle and Sildonia truly be able to return to their world safely?

Everything now rests on the explorers' shoulders...!!
The second half of the "New Saga" collab event starts!
[/p][h2]Dates (JST)[/h2][p]Start: 2025/8/13 (Wed) 17:00
End: 2025/9/3 (Wed) 13:59
[/p][h2]How to Participate[/h2][p][b]① Let's join the Event from NAVI![/b]
Accept the event "New Saga in Alchemy World" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!
1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "New Saga in Alchemy World" from the Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[b]② Defeat the Area Boss and collect items![/b]
You need "Small Silver Key x1" to fight the Area Boss!
Trade "Nightmare Remnant" at Komitt's Exchange!
The "Nightmare Remnant" will drop when you defeat "Black Yoromi"!
*There is no reward for defeating the Area Boss on Hell level.

[b]③ Get items from the event Mamonos and "Nightmare" and trade them for various prizes![/b]
*"Dream Crystal x5" for 1 Play of the Box Gacha.
*Complete the event quest part 2 to play the Box Gacha.
*If you draw the Box Gacha, but you don't have any space in your bag, the item(s) will be stored in your storage.
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

Event Panel Mission is here!
You can get rewards by clearing missions related to the event quest.
During the event, tap the icon on the left of your screen to display the missions.
*You will receive an item box containing one full set of the Theron avatar in a random color.
*Using the item box will give you the avatar items.
*Please note that the event panel mission will end at the same time as the event.

[/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/e704f93d2a19f2f9a337f96f605ef2585974f387.jpg"][/img]
[b]The special rewards for this event are a Theron's Sword and Urza's Dagger!![/b]
Get them and take nice pictures![/p][p]
[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/19b3fac98685cd8ab8ee9fae0a2e01fc5e5ef71d.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/42b374ea78f625835fcde901015bf6f4ad86fe10.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
[/p][h2]Notes[/h2][p]*The event period is subject to change without notice.
*There are no voices in this event.

©2025 Masayuki Abe,AlphaPolis/New Saga Production Committee[/p]

notes.title: New Event "The Great Gate War ～Part 2～" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/fc36b67284cfc03d69488ff62237c762dc45b2ce.png[/img]

At Nagi's request, the explorers set out to investigate an interdimensional gate that led to a city in another world they had visited many times before.

Unfortunately, the city was attacked by Vangizards, invaders from another world.
To make matters worse, the city's modern weapons were ineffective against the invaders, leaving its defenders struggling.

Just when hope was fading, the explorers arrived.
They steadily drove back the Vangizards until a massive gate appeared in the sky... and something far greater emerged: pure despair.

Can the explorers overcome this overwhelming threat?

*We recommend checking out the past events that took place in the Other World City to enjoy this event more. You can check the past events in the Album even if you haven't joined them.

[h2]Dates (JST)[/h2]
Start: 2025/5/28 (Wed) 17:00
End: 2025/6/11 (Wed) 13:59

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]
[h3]① Let's join the Event from NAVI![/h3]
Accept the event "The Great Gate War" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!

1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "The Great Gate War" from the Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[h3]② Defeat Area Boss "Turcannon" and collect items![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/21f2d2313ceb3badf86c9cce9dff1c3ecd23a19b.png[/img]

You need "True Gate Crystal x1" to fight the Area Boss!
Trade "Gate Crystal" at Nagi's Exchange!
The "Gate Crystal" will drop when you defeat "Vangizard"!
*There is no reward for defeating Area Boss "Turcannon" in Hell level.

[h3]③ Get items from the event Mamonos and "Turcannon" and trade them for various prizes![/h3]
*"D Gate Crystal Shard x5" for 1 Play of the Box Gacha.
*Complete the event quest part 2 to play the Box Gacha.
*If you draw the Box Gacha, but you don't have any space in your bag, the item(s) will be stored in your storage.
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

[h2]Event Panel Mission is here![/h2]
You can get rewards by clearing missions related to the event quest.
During the event, tap the icon on the left of your screen to display the missions.

[h2]About Fishing[/h2]
You can catch fish at the fishing points on the event map.
Get event limited fishing baits at Mamono-chan's Exchange and try fishing!
Find out more about fishing here!

[h2]Event Limited Fishing Baits[/h2]
You can use the event-exclusive fishing bait "XL Dango Bait" only at the fishing spot on the event map.
Fishing with the "XL Dango Bait" will give you a higher chance of catching certain fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/3702ace2c19b2fbb854eb32377f79ebc9d19fc44.jpg[/img]
The special rewards for this event are a Crater and Guardian V Head 1!!
Get them and take nice pictures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/ad5e93aaff24733e369869944becd7eaaf05358f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/4f3ea7073d0bbda45fd0f6bbf5b0ad1e5dd8812f.png[/img]

[h2]Notes[/h2]
*The event period is subject to change without notice.
*There are no voices in this event.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/dab3b5a86553dced33e26629fade2b922259115e.jpg[/img]
The explorers set out to investigate the interdimensional gate at Nagi’s request.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/967543233add383e4d4ab2e31a8ba392114c217a.jpg[/img]
We're announcing the contents of our March 19 update!

[h2]Update[/h2]
◆Added 2 new chapters for Main Story Part 2
◆Additional Core Slot Feature
◆Twin Core Feature

[h2]◆Added 2 new chapters for Main Story Part 2[/h2]
*There are no voices in this quest.


[h2]Additional Core Slot Feature[/h2]
This feature allows you to add core slots to some equipment beyond the maximum limit.
Equipment has 0-5 core slots, but the number can be increased by using a special drill.

[h2]About the necessary items to open additional core slots[/h2]
You need a special "Bore Drill" to open additional core slots.
You can get Bore Drills for example from Twin Grande Gacha.


[h2]About Bore Drill types[/h2]
There are several types and rarities of the Bore Drill.
The type and rarity of the drill affect the equipment it can open and the success rate of slot expansion.

Ex)
・Bore Drill+ [1H Sword]: You can open an additional core slot in a random color on the selected "1H Sword" at a 100% probability.
・Bore Drill [Staff]: You can open an additional slot in a random color on a "Staff" at a 10% probability.

[h2]About the equipment in which you can open additional core slots[/h2]
You can open an additional core slot on the following equipment.

・Some Legendary weapons
・Some UR equipment (head, top, bottoms)

[h2]How to open additional core slots[/h2]
You can use this feature by talking to NPC Sumina in the Enhancement Center after clearing the sub-quest "Enhancement Center".

You can get to the Enhancement Center from the southern border (on the State of Abul side).
You can also access it from YOME > Gear Enhancement > Open Slots menu.


[h2]About Twin Cores[/h2]
This item is combined by two colors, such as Red+Red or Red+Blue.
Unlike standard cores, Twin Cores take up two adjacent core slots when set, but they offer incredibly powerful effects.

You can get Twin Cores for example from Twin Grande Gacha.

[h2]How to set Twin Cores[/h2]
Just like standard cores, you can set Twin Cores by talking to NPC Sumina in the Enhancement Center after clearing the sub-quest "Enhancement Center".


You can get to the Enhancement Center from the southern border (on the State of Abul side).
You can also access it from YOME > Gear Enhancement > Core Set menu.

To set a Twin Core, you need two open core slots arranged in the same order as the Twin Core's colors.

Ex) Twin Core Red+Blue:
You need a core slot that's open in the order of Red+Blue.
*You can't set in a Blue+Red core slot.

Twin Core Red+Red:
You need a core slot that's open in the order of Red+Red.
*You can't set if the order is Red+Blue+Red, etc., where the colors are not next to each other.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/967543233add383e4d4ab2e31a8ba392114c217a.jpg[/img]
We're announcing the contents of our December 11 update!

[h2]Update[/h2]
[h2]◆Added 2 new chapters for Main Story Part 2[/h2]
*There are no voices in this quest.


[h2]◆Raised the maximum limit breaks for some Mounts[/h2]
The maximum limit breaks for some Mounts has been raised from ★5 to ★7

[h3]Affected Mounts[/h3]
・Hippogriff
・Futuristic Aircraft
・ARS-111
*Includes some Couple Drive Fest-limited Mounts.

[h3]Limit Break to ★6[/h3]
You need a ★5 Mount and the following materials to limit break to ★6.
・(Mount)'s S Med x1
・200,000 Zells

You can trade "(Mount)'s S Meds" with either 10 "Sublimation Med Drops" (Couple Drive Fest limited Mounts), or 10 "R Sublimation Med Drops" (Couple Driving Gain limited Mounts) depending on the type of the Mount.

You can also get "Sublimation Med Drops" and "R Sublimation Med Drops" at Liz's Mystical Shop > Mount Exchange via the following methods.
・(Mount) Flute/Whistle x1 → "Sublimation Med Drop" x1 or "R Sublimation Med Drop" x1
・(Mount) Miracle Drop x1 → "Sublimation Med Drop" x2 or "R Sublimation Med Drop" x2
*It's different depending on the Mount type.

[h3]Limit Break to ★7[/h3]
You need a ★6 Mount and the following materials to limit break to ★7.
・Some Area Bosses' drop material
・"Material that you can get by Dowsing

*The more difficult the Area Boss is, the more "(Area Boss) Soul Shards" will drop.

notes.title: New Event "The 7 Fendarks!～Part 2～" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/9d08f3c1f217658746bc3992347f1128b3ec9f6d.jpg[/img]
The Chaos Bug seeks to dominate all parallel worlds, wielding a power so immense that even the Fendarks are no match.

There's only one way to stand against this powerful enemy: gathering seven Fendarks from across the parallel worlds.

However, after finding four, the dimensional energy needed to open the gates between worlds runs out.
The Fendarks plan to attack the Chaos Bug's minions, the Mechapas, who are harvesting dimensional energy.
They intend to stop the energy harvest while using it to reopen the gates.

notes.title: New Event "The 7 Fendarks!～Part 1～" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/9d08f3c1f217658746bc3992347f1128b3ec9f6d.jpg[/img]
"Come with me. I can’t save this world without you."
Suddenly, an unfamiliar-looking Fendark appears before you, making this urgent request.
It turns out he's actually a Fendark from another world!
In his world, he's fighting enemies that threaten to invade all parallel worlds, and he's come to seek the explorers' help.
What is the surprising method he reveals to defeat the powerful enemy?!

Can the explorers (and the Fendarks from other worlds) succeed in saving the parallel worlds!?

[h2]Dates (JST)[/h2]
Start: 2024/11/6 (Wed) 17:00
End: 2024/12/18 (Wed) 13:59

[h3]① Let's join the Event from NAVI![/h3]
Accept the event "The 7 Fendarks!" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!

1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "The 7 Fendarks!" from the Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[h3]② Let's collect event items![/h3]
You will have a chance to get "Dimensional Energy" and "Dimensional Energy EX" by defeating certain [table][tr][th]Area[/th][th]Lv[/th][th]Mamono[/th][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Beg[/td][td]-[/td][td]Mechapa[/td][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Int[/td][td]-[/td][td]Mechapa[/td][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Adv[/td][td]-[/td][td]Mechapa[/td][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Super[/td][td]Lv60 or higher[/td][td]Mechapa[/td][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Hell[/td][td]Lv70 or higher[/td][td]Mechapa[/td][/tr][/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/29f4ae1d3e29805f4f39aa5582972412d2bc9b0a.png[/img]

[h3]③ Progress the event and you will be able to trade the items you collected with other great items![/h3]
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

[h3]④Travel to the other world[/h3]
Talk to Angel Fendark on the event map "Part 1: Reception"!
You can enter other worlds!
*You are able to play the event quests.

[h2]About Fishing[/h2]
You can catch fish at the fishing points on the event map.
Get event limited fishing baits at Cave Fendark's Exchange and try fishing!
Find out more about fishing here!

[h2]Event Limited Fishing Baits[/h2]
You can use the event limited fishing bait "Chaotic Fishing Bait" only at the fishing points on the event map.
You will have better chances to catch certain fish when using the "Chaotic Fishing Bait".

[h2]About Treasure Map[/h2]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/967543233add383e4d4ab2e31a8ba392114c217a.jpg[/img]
We're announcing the contents of our October 2 update!

[h2]Update[/h2]
◆Raised the maximum limit breaks for some Mounts
The maximum limit breaks for some Mounts has been raised from ★5 to ★7

[h2]Affected Mounts[/h2]
・Mirror Ball
・Double Bed
・Giant Catfish
・Medjed
・Crescent Moon
・Gram
*Includes some Couple Driving -Gain-limited Mounts.

[h2]Limit Break to ★6[/h2]
You need a ★5 Mount and the following materials to limit break to ★6.
・(Mount)'s S Med x1
・200,000 Zells

You can trade "(Mount)'s S Meds" with either 10 "Sublimation Med Drops" (Couple Drive Fest limited Mounts), or 10 "R Sublimation Med Drops" (Couple Driving Gain limited Mounts) depending on the type of the Mount.

You can also get "Sublimation Med Drops" and "R Sublimation Med Drops" at Liz's Mystical Shop > Mount Exchange via the following methods.
・(Mount) Flute/Whistle x1 → "Sublimation Med Drop" x1 or "R Sublimation Med Drop" x1
・(Mount) Miracle Drop x1 → "Sublimation Med Drop" x2 or "R Sublimation Med Drop" x2
*It's different depending on the Mount type.

[h2]Limit Break to ★7[/h2]
You need a ★6 Mount and the following materials to limit break to ★7.
・Some Area Bosses' drop material

notes.content:

However, so many couples wanted to get married that there were not enough churches to hold the ceremonies.

notes.title: New Event "Money Hungry Monster～Part 1～" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/0ea9a58b4441c654bfd05a62f002e9f07bb0f25c.jpg[/img]
The explorers meet Rabbin, a Mamono from another world, by chance.
He has come to this world to look for help.
The group heads to Rabbin's house to hear more details, however, on the way they are discovered by a Mamono named Zellmi, who collects taxes from them.

And that was the problem Rabbin needed help with...

Can Rabbin break free from the money-hungry monster's rule?!

End: 2024/6/12 (Wed) 13:59

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]

Accept the event "Money Hungry Monster" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!

1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "Money Hungry Monster" from the Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

*The side to whom Zodiac Sign was added by this effect does not have the effect that enhances all allies.

◆Finishing Touch Pose
Triggers extra damage according to ATK and increases damage limit to "Finishing Touch-Supreme" effect

◆Enhances by stages
Enhances the attacking skill when using "1st Stage" or "Stage"

【Nirvana】
◆Sage Spirit
Enhances the effect that increases damage limit every time when used (max 3 steps)

◆Heavenly Thunder
Enhances ATK value
When the 3rd stage of "Sage Spirit" is in effect, triggers extra damage according to wind ATK

◆Dragon Flash
Enhances ATK value

notes.title: Teamwork! "Bond Hideouts" are here! December 20 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/0b94e12e19282978a71e348eb37c60001af7dc22.jpg[/img]
[h2]What are "Hideouts"?[/h2]
This feature allows you and your Bond members to build your own Hideout.
You can also obtain Hideout EXP and Hideout Points by completing "Bond Quests", which are implemented at the same time as the Hideout feature.
The "Boost" function activates by using the "Hideout Points" and gives you various buff effects.
As your Hideout level increases, the amount of "Boost" buffs increases, and the rewards for "Bond Quests" change.


[h2]Hideout Information[/h2]
You can see HIdeout information from Menu > Interact > Bond.

[h3]Hideout Status[/h3]
You can check details about your Hideout.
Bond Name　　　　　　・・・Name of your current Bond
Hideout Level　　　　・・・Current Hideout level
HIdeouit Points　　　・・・HIdeout Points your Bond currently has
My Hideout Points　・・・My Hideout Points you currently have
Current EXP　　　　・・・Total of current Hideout EXP
Until Next Lv　　　・・・Amount of Hideout EXP required to level up
You can also check the Boosts you've learned at each level and those currently in effect.

[h3]Boost[/h3]
You can activate Boosts.
You can also check the Boosts that are currently activated.
Bond Quests
You can check details about Bond Quests.


[h2]What are "Boosts"?[/h2]
You can access Boosts from Menu > Interact > Hideout Information > Boost.
There are two types of Boosts: "Overall" and "Individual"
Overall Boost
You can activate up to 3 Boosts.
You need 100 Hideout Points to activate one Boost.
By activating the Boost, all Bond members will get the effects.
The Boost is activated for 24 hours.
Individual Boost
You can activate up to 3 Boosts.
You need My Hideout Points to activate a Boost.
You can activate one Boost for 1 hour with 10 My Hideout Points. (If you want to activate a Boost for a longer time, you are charged more points. )
You can activate them for up to 100 hours.

[h2]About the function to manage permissions to change Hideout boosts[12/27 Update][/h2]
You can check boost permissions via Menu> Interact> Bond> Change Permissions.
The bond leader can grant permission to activate Hideout boosts to each bond member.
*All members' permissions will be disabled as default.
*Permissions can be changed by the bond leader.

[h2]What are "Bond Quests"?[/h2]
You can access Bond Quests from Menu > Interact > Bond > Bond Quest.
There are weekly "Co-op Quests" that you can play with your Bond members, as well as daily "Solo Quests" that you can play by yourself.

[h3]Co-op Quests[/h3]
You can play the selected quest with your Bond members each week.
The quests and rewards you can get change by the Bond level.
*Co-op Quests update every Monday at 0:00 JST.
*The Bond level you have by Sunday at 20:00 JST will be reflected.
*The quest status will reset during the update.
*Even if there is a similar quest after the update, your previous progress will not be transferred.
*If a Mamono is defeated while being in the same party with the same Bond members, the progress level will not be duplicated.
*About new Bond members
┗The quest is automatically accepted from the next update after the member has joined.
┗New members won't get the rewards from the week they joined.
┗If you leave the Bond before receiving your reward and rejoin the same Bond, you will become a new Bond member and will not receive the reward for that week's Co-op Quest.

[h3]◆Co-op Quest Rewards[/h3]
Rewards can be received when the Bond Leader presses the receive button on the Co-op Quest list.
Hideout Points, Hideout EXP, and Bond Donations will be added to your Bond when you receive the rewards.
Other rewards will be sent to the Limited Time Reward Box.

[h3]Solo Quests[/h3]
Daily quests for Bond members to play by themselves.
Only the player who clears the quests can receive the rewards.
The rewards will be sent directly to your bag after pressing the receive button.
*About rejoining a Bond
┗If you leave the Bond and rejoin it before completing the Solo Quests or receiving the rewards, your status will be carried over.
┗If you leave the Bond after receiving the Solo Quest rewards and then rejoin the Bond, your Solo Quest status will be carried over.
┗Individual points you got before leaving the Bond will be carried over when you rejoin another Bond.

notes.title: Become even stronger! "Tower of Time: Night" is here! December 6 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/9dd9528d60560691f26ba16ffd41a67b417db16c.jpg[/img]
[h2]What's "Tower of Time: Night"?[/h2]
It's a new solo feature where players can strengthen their rank 3 and extra jobs.
Together with your YOME, you can reach the higher floors while defeating enemies, which enables you to strengthen your status and skills.
Each floor's enhancement rewards can only be received once per week, and the acquisition history and achievements reset every Monday at 0:00 JST.

[h2]Conditions[/h2]
・You must have accepted the quest "Let's Climb The Tower!"
・You must clear the quest "Request for Cokes"
・Your current job must be Lv 90 or above.

When you move to the Tower of Time 1F while meeting the above conditions, you can accpet the exclusive quest "Tower of the Night".
After that, you can proceed from the movement point in the Tower of Time 2F to the Tower of Time: Night 1F. (*Only if your current job is at level 90)
After moving, the entrance to the next floor is closed, and you can only enter it by defeating the enemies there.

[h2]About "Tower of Time: Night"[/h2]
At the beginning of a battle, a damage restriction is added to the enemies in the Tower of Time: Night, preventing you from dealing more than a certain amount of damage.
Look for ways to relax or remove the restricition and be creative in how you fight to aim for bigger damage!
Also, you cannot revive during the battles at the Tower of Time: Night, so make sure to fight in cooperation with your YOME to avoid being defeated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/e1e614e2ebd1877444dd52707903c9f1c6cc740a.jpg[/img]
Damage restriction icon


[h2]Rewards[/h2]
By defeating the enemies on the regular floors, you can get "Time Skip Coin (Dusk)" , "Soul Shard", and "Coins" based on your current job.
You can get these once per week per floor.
In addition, at the boss floors located every fifth floor, when you win the battle and use "Soul Shard" you can get a "Soul" based on your current job.
Even if you go to the next floor without using a "Soul Shard", you can use it and get the "Soul" if you retry the battle.
*You can choose to use the "Soul Shard" only at the end of a battle if you win. There is no weekly limit to the rewards you can get when using it.

[h2]Passive Skill Acquistion, Item Trade[/h2]
The "Coin", "Soul", and "Time Skip Coin (Dusk)" you get can be traded for passive skills and items at the Merchant's Exchange in the Tower of Time 2F.
The passive skills enhance your status and also boost the effects when enhancing skills or getting buffs from your allies.
*You can trade passive skills only once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/95074044435d0bc3936eb37b40b234f9f6ab0525.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Event "Another World Tree Crisis～Part 2～" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/87bbfff299abf31368d54df5c318454782bc3744.jpg[/img]

The Dark Queen has attacked to steal the power of the World Tree.
Under the command of Prince Hakuro, you managed to attack the Dark Queen back, but her men seemed to be secretly continuing to steal power from the World Tree.
While the situation was in deadlock with the Treent side having a slight advantage, the Dark Queen, who had been missing, finally made her move...!

What's the Dark Queen's secret plan?
Will the explorers be able to defeat her?!

Even though the world is wrapped in darkness and despair, we must not give up.
Miracles happen for those who keep fighting...

[h2]Dates (JST)[/h2]
Start: 2023/11/29 (Wed) 18:00
End: 2023/12/20 (Wed) 13:59

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]
[h3]① Let's join the Event from NAVI![/h3]
Accept the event "Another World Tree Crisis" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!

1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "Another World Tree Crisis" from the Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[h3]② Defeat Area Boss "Dark Queen" and collect items![/h3]
You need "World Tree's Guidance" to fight the Area Boss!
Let's exchange "World Tree Piece" and "World Tree's Guidance" in Treen's exchange!
Let's exchange "World Tree Pieces" and "World Tree's Guidance" in Treen's exchange!
*There is no reward for defeating Area Boss "Dark Queen" in Hell level.

[h3]③ Get items from the event Mamonos and "Dark Queen" and trade them for various prizes![/h3]
*You need "Queen's Power Cluster x5" for 1 Play of the Box Gacha.
*Complete the event quest part 2 to play the Box Gacha.
*If you draw the Box Gacha, but you don't have any space in your bag, the item(s) will be stored in your storage.
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

[h2]Event Panel Mission is here![/h2]
You can get rewards by clearing missions related to the event quest.
During the event, tap the icon on the left of your screen to display the missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/88afd18903d3de42a1678ccdf2abc95243987895.png[/img]
The special rewards for this event are Dark Queen series and Em: Hero Pose!!
Get them and take nice pictures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/9f0fa153380c30a177f9ff467a5d203c78b53fe9.png[/img]

*The event period is subject to change without notice.
*There are no voices in this event.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/87bbfff299abf31368d54df5c318454782bc3744.jpg[/img]
Prince Hakuro has called the explorers to the royal castle.
He tells you that the State of Abul was put in charge of the anniversary celebration this year too, and so they had instructed the Enhancement Center to create extra-large fireworks.
However, a gate to another world suddenly appeared during the creation of the fireworks. Moreover, the world beyond the gate was the same world with the World Tree as last year and Treents were asking for help...

Hakuro again decides to help the Treents.
Will the explorers be able to support Hakuro and protect the World Tree?

notes.title: Event "Spirit Wars (Wind Spirit)" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/2ac8258986c3f76a53d7dd1809c6a3dc0f0d9d0b.jpg[/img]

[h2]What's Spirit Wars (Wind Spirit)?[/h2]
Spirit Wars is a limited One-Time Party that you can challenge with level 70+ Jobs.

When you win in the battle, you'll get materials to create a powerful "Spirit Weapon".
*YOME will not join the Spirit Wars.
Find more details about One-Time Party here

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/ca3dbbc6f4bf3d049225336f7b37d39df32a5ac6.png[/img]

[h2]Period(JST)[/h2]
Start: 2023/9/6 (Wed) 18:00
End: 2023/9/20 (Wed) 13:59

[h2]Requirements to join "Spirit Wars (Wind Spirit)"[/h2]
・Level 70 or above
・Cleared Ch.87 Windy Mission
・The following items (the required amount depends on the level)
　┗[Adv / Adv+] : Wind Amphibole x3
　┗[Hell] : Wind Amphibole x5

If you meet the requirements above, you can join from Navi > One-Time Party > Event.
You can also join from Navi > Event.

[h2]About the required items to challenge the Spirit Wars[/h2]
Defeat Beg/Int "Teba-King" to get 1 of the items that you need to challenge the Spirit Wars.
*You need an Area Boss Tix to fight the Beg/Int Boss.

[h3]Bosses who drop the items[/h3]
[Beg] Teba-King: If you succeed in defeating the Boss, it will drop 1 Wind Amphibole
[Int] Teba-King: If you succeed in defeating the Boss, it will drop 2 Wind Amphiboles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/e736dd09300df1eaa569cf09af89a374f17a36fc.png[/img]



[h2]About Spirit Weapons[/h2]
Collect materials in the Spirit Wars to trade Spirit Weapons at "Liz's Mystical Shop".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/a19cd95cfb403661858344f19079d20ade310f98.png[/img]

Awakened Spirit Weapons will have special effects on their appearance, and in rare cases, they will deal additional damage based on their Wind element value.
*The Awakening materials will drop only at "Hell" level.

[h3]Weapons that can be created with Spirit Wars (Wind Spirit) materials[/h3]
・【1-handed Axe】Elemental Hawk
　┗【Awakened】Elemental Hawk W
・【Bow】Elemental Shooter
　┗【Awakened】Elemental Shooter W
・【Knuckles】Elemental Jamadhars
　┗【Awakened】Elemental Jamadhars W

[h2]Added katana to Spirit Weapons[/h2]
You can make katanas with "Sumina" at the Enhancement Center after collecting the necessary materials.
Learn more about katanas here

[h3][New materials available at Spirit Wars with the addition of the katana][/h3]
・Wind Arms Shard [KTN]

[h3][Weapons that you can make with materials from Spirit Wars (Flame Spirit)][/h3]
・ [KTN]Soul Katana of Wind
　┗[After forging]Soul Katana of Wind X

[h2]Added item drops for learning Receptor skills![/h2]
Defeat the target enemy as a Receptor to get the drops.
You can learn the skills by trading a special skill item with Rein in front of the Enhancement Center,

[h3][Items that you can get at Spirit Wars][/h3]
・R: Heal Wind

notes.title: New Event "Horror of Sunday the 31st～Part 2～" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/086cb448e0bc2035ddfad4952b7531f63b6f6ed4.png[/img]
The explorers keep exterminating the Soul Servants.
And then finally, they get the results of the investigation about the Curse Remnants.
It seems that the Curse Remnants are the source of the Soul Servants' power, and so if the explorers continue to exterminate them and collect the Curse Remnants, there is a high possibility that they will be able to wipe out all of the Soul Servants from the camp.

The guests are excited by this hope, but further despair looms over them!

Will the guests survive the camp?!

*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

You need "Curse Remnants" to fight the Area Boss!
You can get "Curse Remnants" by defeating Soul Servant!
*There is no reward for defeating Area Boss "Jayson" in Hell level.

[h3]③ Get items from the event Mamonos and "Jayson" and trade them for various prizes![/h3]
*You need "Released Curse Crystal x5" for 1 Play of the Box Gacha.
*Complete the event quest part 2 to play the Box Gacha.
*If you draw the Box Gacha, but you don't have any space in your bag, the item(s) will be stored in your storage.
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

This feature allows players to receive specific rewards that they were unable to receive due to disconnection or other reasons. The items will be stored for a certain period of time and the players will be able to receive them.

[h3]Rewards that can be stored[/h3]
・Reward for defeating a Boss in Party Dungeons
・Reward for defeating Mamonos in Tower of Time Basement
・Reward for defeating Area Bosses
・Reward for defeating Bosses in Spirit Wars

[h3]How to receive the rewards[/h3]
・After meeting the requirements for storing the reward, it can be received from the "Limited Time Box" icon.

[h3]Notes[/h3]
・You will not be able to receive the items after a certain period of time.
・Time will be counted during maintenance as well.
・Only rewards for defeating Mamonos will be stored. Quest rewards will not be stored.
・There is a limit to the number of items that can be stored in the Limited Time Reward Box. Once the limit is exceeded, the reward will not be stored even if the conditions are met.
If there are no items available in the Limited Time Reward Box, the icon for receiving items will not be displayed.

notes.content:

The explorers were collecting back the stolen cargo.
In the midst of that, Liz finds a rare piece of Black Metal and gets excited over it.
However, it seems that the metal lures the Sea Intruders' bosses...

2. Accept "Creatures Under The Sea" from the Event tab.

*There is no reward for defeating Area Boss "Sea Pirate" in Hell level.

*Complete the event quest part 2 to play the Box Gacha.
*If you draw the Box Gacha, but you don't have any space in your bag, the item(s) will be stored in your storage.
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

notes.content:

Many Mamonos expecting a battle event gathered at the venue, but due to King Lindow's arrangements, in addition to the ball, they also decided to hold a tournament.

The festival was packed with guests.

*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

notes.title: Event "Spirit Wars (Earth Spirit)" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/2b60f35b0f74884efaeacde85dffe44cce5bca3e.png[/img]

What's Spirit Wars (Earth Spirit)?
Spirit Wars is a limited One-Time Party that you can challenge with level 70+ Jobs.

When you win in the battle, you'll get materials to create a powerful "Spirit Weapon".
*YOME will not join the Spirit Wars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/029a93c9c2eaf909404a9eece75bc65f9299c87f.png[/img]

[h2]Period(JST)[/h2]
Start: 2023/5/10 (Wed) 18:00
End: 2023/5/24 (Wed) 13:59

[h2]Requirements to join "Spirit Wars (Earth Spirit)"[/h2]
・Level 70 or above
・Cleared Ch. 82 Spirit Sword
・The following items (the required amount depends on the level)
┗[Adv / Adv+] : Earth Amphibole x3
┗[Hell] : Earth Amphibole x5

If you meet the requirements above, you can join from Navi > One-Time Party > Event.
You can also join from Navi > Event.

[h2]About the required items to challenge the Spirit Wars[/h2]
Defeat Beg/Int "Earth Servant" to get 1 of the items that you need to challenge the Spirit Wars.
*You need an Area Boss Tix to fight the Beg/Int Boss.

[h3]Bosses who drop the items[/h3]
[Beg] Earth Servant: If you succeed in defeating the Boss, it will drop 1 Earth Amphibole
[Int] Earth Servant: If you succeed in defeating the Boss, it will drop 2 Earth Amphiboles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/029a93c9c2eaf909404a9eece75bc65f9299c87f.png[/img]

[h2]About Spirit Weapons[/h2]
Collect materials in the Spirit Wars to trade Spirit Weapons at "Liz's Mystical Shop".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/bc0235faa516974896a375a6ca1abc03e7abddea.png[/img]

Awakened Spirit Weapons will have special effects on their appearance, and in rare cases, they will deal additional damage based on their earth element value.
Also, awakened Spirit Weapon shields will have a reduced damage effect instead of the additional damage.
*The Awakening materials will drop only at "Hell" level.

[h3]Weapons that can be created with Spirit Wars (Earth Spirit) materials[/h3]
・[1H Sword]Elemental Sword
 ┗ [Awakened] Elemental Sword E
・[2H Axe]Elemental Hammer
 ┗ [Awakened] Elemental Hammer E
・[Shield]Elemental Shield
 ┗ [Awakened] Elemental Shield E

[h2]Added katana to Spirit Weapons[/h2]
You can make katanas with "Sumina" at the Enhancement Center after collecting the necessary materials.
Learn more about katanas here

[h3][New materials available at Spirit Wars with the addition of the katana][/h3]
・Earth Arms Shard [KTN]

[h3][Weapons that you can make with materials from Spirit Wars (Earth Spirit)][/h3]
・ [KTN]Soul Katana of Earth
 ┗ [After forging]Soul Katana of Earth X

[h2]Added item drops for learning Receptor skills![/h2]
Defeat the target enemy as a Receptor to get the drops.
You can learn the skills by trading a special skill item with Rein in front of the Enhancement Center,

[h3][New materials available at Spirit Wars with the addition of the item][/h3]
・R:Mystic Thunder Armor

notes.content:

The explorers are stopped by Richard in town.
It seems that a hole had appeared on the outskirts of the Duchy of Schlinger that led to a different dimension.
Richard sent out a team to investigate, and they found that the hole was connected to some ancient ruins.
They tried to investigate the area, but were forced to retreat when a pack of Mamonos appeared from the depths of the ruins.
He therefore asked the explorers to assist him in defeating the Mamonos and investigating.

The explorers accepted the request and headed for the ruins.
But what awaited them there...?

notes.title: New Event "White Chocolate Falls!～Part 1～" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/4b677d96f3aefe5d24bd0cbd28ec9b4e7ea62ae8.png[/img]

An aristocrat was looking for the explorer's help.
Steve sent you to meet a handsome lord of the castle.

What exactly is she concerned about?
Will the explorers be able to help her?!

[h2]Dates (JST)[/h2]
End: 2023/3/15 (Wed) 14:00

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]
[h3]① Let's join the Event from NAVI![/h3]
Accept the event "White Chocolate Falls!" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!

1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "White Chocolate Falls!" from Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[h3]② Let's collect event items![/h3]
How to collect the event items "White Chocolate Butter" and "Chocolate Butter Clump"

[h3]③ Progress the event and you will be able to trade the items you collected with other great items![/h3]
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

[h2]Event Achievements[/h2]
Clear the event limited achievements to earn a special title!
You can find the achievements from YOME > Navi > Achievements!

[h2]Event Panel Mission is here![/h2]
You can get rewards by clearing missions related to the event quest.
During the event, tap the icon on the left of your screen to display the missions.

[h2]Event limited item[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/ebc4703e9121fedfee9ab7b43c928bd39f4bfa5f.png[/img]
The special rewards for this event are Rich Cloak and Sweet Camera Set!!
Wear the cloak and take amazing pictures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/d1c28eea121da900ce7dca8f8ac5ff5d2d567e2f.png[/img]

[h3]Notes[/h3]
*The event period is subject to change without notice.
